sehemu: Part II: High Court of the United Republic
maudhui: A Judge of the High Court shall not assume the functions of his office until he has first taken and subscribed the oath of allegiance and any other oath relating to the proper discharge of his office which may be prescribed by a law enacted by Parliament.
